name: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom

achievements.name: Tri Rod
achievements.detail: Meet Tri and take the Tri Rod.

achievements.name: First Echo
achievements.detail: Copy an object with the Tri Rod and learn its echo.

achievements.name: Monster Echo
achievements.detail: Learn a monster's echo and summon it to fight for you.

achievements.name: Still World
achievements.detail: Enter a rift and travel through the Still World beyond it.

achievements.name: Suthorn Ruins
achievements.detail: Clear Suthorn Ruins and defeat the boss at the end.

achievements.name: Swordfighter Form
achievements.detail: Win a fight while Swordfighter Form is active.

achievements.name: Jabul Waters
achievements.detail: Clear Jabul Ruins and mend the rift over Jabul Waters.

achievements.name: Gerudo Desert
achievements.detail: Clear the Gerudo Sanctum and mend the rift in the Gerudo Desert.

achievements.name: Castle Rift
achievements.detail: Clear the dungeon in the Hyrule Castle rift and restore the people it took.

achievements.name: Highland Rifts
achievements.detail: Mend the rifts at Eldin Volcano, the Faron Wetlands, and Hebra Mountain.

achievements.name: Fresh Smoothie
achievements.detail: Blend gathered ingredients into a smoothie.

achievements.name: Neighbor's Favor
achievements.detail: Finish a side quest for someone living in Hyrule.

achievements.name: Hyrule Restored
achievements.detail: Finish the story and make the kingdom whole again.
